name: Resource Monitor
description: Draws live CPU, RAM and GPU graphs for the player on its own statistics page.
info:
Samples Luma CPU/RAM and the player's own GPU usage: the renderer measures its GPU time where the driver supports it, otherwise the player's per-process utilization is read from nvidia-smi on NVIDIA. The system-wide GPU figure is only shown, labelled as such, when neither is available.
Enable it and approve process access.
Open Statistics (I), then press 3 (or its assigned number).
Graphs cover the last ~2 minutes.
